children: Flex strengthened its financing for the EPC Power acquisition with two short-term facilities totaling $4.4 billion. The company entered a new $1.1 billion senior bridge term loan on October 9, 2026, fully drawn on October 14, 2026, and maturing 364 days after funding. Flex also drew $3.3 billion on a previously executed 364-day senior term loan signed September 29, 2026. Both facilities, led by Citibank as administrative agent, carry floating rates tied to Term SOFR or the Base Rate with ratings-based margins and include customary covenants. Proceeds funded the purchase price and related fees, with the $3.3 billion facility required to be prepaid upon anticipated Axiom financing at spin-off.
